follow100Note: Rows add up exactly to the profit kept.
oneTimers: Stock-based compensation was $492M in the quarter — the main reason non-GAAP net income ($1,010M) is about double the GAAP figure ($502M). The cost is real; it is paid in shares instead of cash.
Severance costs of $24M in the quarter ($53M in the first nine months) — excluded from the non-GAAP figures.
Business combination and other related costs of $19M, mostly tied to acquisitions — also excluded from non-GAAP results.
The board authorized a five-for-one stock split, subject to shareholder approval at a special meeting on December 5, 2025. The EPS figures above are pre-split.
otherDetail: Other income netted to +$122M: $115M of interest earned on cash, plus $7M of other income.

segments.name: Subscription
segments.note: Software subscriptions — companies paying to run their workflows on ServiceNow, increasingly including its AI agents. 97% of all revenue.

segments.name: Professional services
segments.note: Implementation help and training — people who set the platform up for customers.

sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Total revenue grew 22% and subscription revenue 21.5%, with the company saying it exceeded guidance on every topline growth and profitability metric — and it raised its full-year targets for subscription revenue, operating margin, and free cash flow.
takeaways.title: Growth beat guidance across the board

takeaways.text: Remaining performance obligations hit $24.3B, up 24% — revenue already contracted but not yet delivered. The next 12 months alone hold $11.35B (current RPO, +21%), and 553 customers now spend over $5M a year each, up 18%.
takeaways.title: Future revenue keeps stacking

takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $2.40; excluding stock pay and one-offs it was $4.82. Stock-based pay of $492M is the single biggest gap between the two profit measures.
takeaways.title: Two very different profits

verdict: ServiceNow grew revenue 22% to $3.4B, beat its own guidance on every topline and profitability metric, and pre-sold another $24.3B of future business — while GAAP profit rose 16% to $502M.
